timestamp_semantics.journal: paired realtime and monotonic timestamps in integer microseconds
timestamp_semantics.clock_assumption: No unobserved canceling realtime clock steps between the historical scope-start/end records. Offset spread is reported; this is not a proof of a continuously stable clock.

native_response_timing_semantics: Native ttftMs is client first-chunk time minus request start; serverFirstTokenMs is client first-chunk time minus sentAt and still includes transport. streamDurationMs spans received stream chunks. These do not isolate provider computation.
